text:
Maya Chen: Morning — new hire here, trying to ssh into the bastion to test my infra access but getting 'Connection timed out'. I completed the Okta SSO VPN step in the onboarding doc. Who can help check VPC/bastion access?
Samir Patel: hey @Maya Chen — welcome! Quick questions: what OS/client are you on, and are you on home wifi or company network? Can you paste the `ssh -vvv bastion.redwood.internal` output? Also confirm device enrollment (Jamf/MDM).
Maya Chen: macOS 13.6, using the built-in VPN SAML flow (not Tailscale). Device is enrolled in Jamf. `ssh -vvv` ends with: "connect to 10.12.1.5 port 22: Operation timed out"
Al Rodriguez: FYI we use split-tunnel policies for dev VPCs. The VPN should push the 10.12.0.0/16 route. Can you run `route -n get 10.12.1.5` or `netstat -rn | grep 10.12` and paste results?
Maya Chen: `route -n get 10.12.1.5` -> response: "route to 10.12.1.5: no route to host"
IT-Bot: Ticket created: INFRA-4721 and assigned to @Samir Patel. Please attach logs and any command outputs.
Samir Patel: thanks. Sounds like the VPN didn't push routes to your mac. Try disconnect/reconnect first. If that fails, paste `ifconfig` output (just the vpn interface block). Also checking on our side: we recently tweaked bastion SGs and the vpn policy group mapping — your user needs the 'onboarded-engineer' group to get the route pushed. @Lia Gomez from people-ops can confirm your group.
Lia Gomez: Looks like your Okta account is still in 'new-hires' and wasn't promoted to 'onboarded-engineer' due to a timing quirk. I'll promote you now, should sync in a couple mins.
Lia Gomez: done — your groups are updated. Try reconnecting in ~2 minutes.
Maya Chen: Reconnected — can ssh into bastion now, thanks everyone! Quick note: on mac the built-in VPN client shows a modal during SAML that asks to allow route changes. If you click the wrong option the client accepts split-tunnel but doesn't add routes.
Samir Patel: good catch. Can you paste the exact modal text so we can update onboarding docs? We'll also add a quick sanity-check command to the checklist.
Maya Chen: The prompt said: 'Allow Redwood VPN to add routes' with a checkbox 'Allow only specific traffic'. I clicked allow but it defaulted to split-tunnel and didn't add the internal route.
Morgan (DevEx): thanks — filing a tiny docs PR to call this out and include `route -n get 10.12.1.5` as a verification step.
Ops-Bot: INFRA-4721 status changed to Resolved.
Samir Patel: welcome aboard again, and thanks for the heads-up — we'll tweak the doc and add a quick onboarding validation script. :thumbsup:
